fields.label: PLAYORA crypto payments and service protection — hosted checkout
fields.remedies.cancellation: After payment is confirmed, orders cannot be cancelled simply because you change your mind. If payment, delivery or the agreed service has a problem, contact order support. This rule does not reduce a full refund owed for an unfulfilled agreement, failed or incorrect delivery, an account remedy due under the accepted terms, or any cancellation, withdrawal or refund right required by law. Existing accepted orders retain their original terms.
fields.remedies.missed_target: If we miss an accepted rank, win-rate, hero/role restriction, item, quantity, guaranteed deadline or other agreed condition, we refund 100% of the affected order purchase amount. Conditions are defined per package or accepted order, not by a global win-rate target. Account purchase issues are reviewed against the accepted listing, delivery records and evidence. Any refund eligibility and amount follow that review, the accepted order terms and applicable law. Previously accepted agreements retain their protections. Verified damage caused by our team is reviewed for separate fair monetary compensation under the accepted terms.
fields.remedies.no_show: If our team fails an agreed attendance or guaranteed scheduling condition, the full-refund promise applies. If required customer access or availability is missing, we explain the issue and agree how to proceed; we do not silently complete the order or invent a no-show fee. An estimate is not a guaranteed deadline, and a change to an actual guarantee requires customer agreement.
fields.remedies.partial_work: If PLAYORA fails an agreed deliverable or condition, the affected order receives a 100% refund even if part of the work was completed. We do not deduct partial work, administration or original processing costs. A repair, repeat service, replacement or extension is optional for the customer when a full refund is due.
fields.remedies.refund_basis: A full refund returns 100% of the purchase payment allocated to the affected order, including charges collected by PLAYORA for it. By default we return the original crypto asset and original number of units allocated to the order. A different supported asset/network or valuation requires the customer's express agreement to the exact amount first. Previous partial refunds count toward that same order total. Excess and duplicate payments are accounted for separately and never become a site balance. Direct third-party wallet/exchange costs and later market-value changes are not part of the order purchase amount; applicable additional rights remain. Confirm a safe recipient asset/network/address with authenticated support; an exchange sending address is not automatically a refund destination.
fields.remedies.refund_fees: PLAYORA pays the outgoing refund fee so it does not reduce an eligible full refund. We do not deduct administration or our original processing costs. PLAYORA also covers outgoing fees on agreed account-damage compensation. Separately charged wallet/exchange sending fees paid directly to third parties are not included in the order purchase amount, without restricting any further remedy required by law. We aim to assess a claim within 72 hours of necessary evidence and initiate an approved refund within 48 hours of confirming a usable destination, respecting any shorter legal deadline. Provider checks or complex reviews receive an explanation and updates at least every 48 hours while action is pending. Completion requires verified transfer evidence.
fields.text:
Orders are priced in USD and paid directly through our secure hosted checkout. Choose an available cryptocurrency and network on that payment page; the available choices, conversion and minimum payment requirements are shown there. There is no customer wallet or account top-up. Use only the exact asset, network, address, amount and any memo shown by that checkout. Sending a different asset or using another network does not match its payment instructions.

The exchange-rate mode is fixed for the provider's valid quote. The PLAYORA checkout window is 30 minutes; it does not extend a payment quote or guarantee that stock remains reserved after this window. A payment link remaining accessible does not extend this window. Follow the payment page's current instructions and quote validity, and never send using expired instructions. PLAYORA pays the provider processing fees; wallet or exchange sending fees charged directly to you remain your responsibility. Make sure the full displayed payment amount reaches the checkout destination.

Payment is complete only after provider evidence is verified and allocated to your order. A screenshot or transaction hash alone is not proof of payment. Underpayments, excess or duplicate transfers, late payments and wrong-route payments require review. Do not send additional funds without fresh authenticated instructions. Provider or network delays never simulate a successful payment, and a late transfer cannot reserve stock already sold. Contact support if anything is unclear; never share a seed phrase or private key.

The accepted package or order defines every rank, win-rate, hero, role, quantity, delivery and other service condition. If PLAYORA fails an agreed deliverable or condition, you are entitled to a 100% refund of the affected order's purchase amount; partial work does not reduce it. A repeat service, replacement or extension is optional when a refund is due. Account purchase issues are reviewed against the accepted listing, delivery records and evidence. We explain any remedy due under the accepted order terms and applicable law; refund eligibility and amount depend on that review, rather than a blanket guarantee for every post-delivery issue. Completing an order does not by itself prevent a review. Previously accepted agreements retain their protections. Verified account damage caused by our team is assessed for fair monetary compensation separately from the order refund, without automatically capping it at the order price or making an undisputed refund depend on agreement about compensation.

For completed boosting and shop orders, the standard in-app dispute window is 365 days after completion. Account listings retain their separately accepted in-app reporting window. An in-app appeal may be submitted within 30 days of a decision, up to 3 appeals. These interface limits do not remove the refund, account-protection or compensation rights in your accepted terms or any applicable legal rights. If an in-app option is unavailable or its window has ended, contact your order's support conversation or support@playoragames.com for staff review. Existing accepted orders retain their own terms. Support is available 24/7.

scope: Only prospective account-remedy wording changed; all financial settings and accepted historical agreements retained.
